behavioral_signatures: Ransomware encrypting files and demanding payment
Mobile trojans delivered via SMS or phishing links
Phishing campaigns targeting credentials or financial assets
Exploitation of browser or OS vulnerabilities for privilege escalation
Abuse of legitimate cloud messaging services for C2 communication

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for ransomware behaviors (file encryption, ransom notes), suspicious SMS or email links leading to APK downloads or credential phishing, exploitation attempts against known vulnerabilities (CVE-2020-17087, CVE-2020-14882, CVE-2020-0796), and unusual use of cloud messaging services for C2. Use endpoint protection, network monitoring, and patch management to detect and prevent these threats.
